| Field    | Type   | Required | Description                                                        |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `type`   | string | Yes      | `"list_sessions"`                                                  |
| `limit`  | number | No       | Most rows to return, a non-negative integer                        |
| `before` | object | No       | The last row the client saw, `{updatedAt, sessionId}`, to page on |
